title: Describe committed source size
responsibility: Summarize the sizes recorded in the source tree without reading file content.

inputs.name: hubSize.context
inputs.description: Source context supplying the tree entries searched for requested paths; this function reads only entries, each entry's path, and its size. It does not read file contents.

inputs.name: hubSize.paths
inputs.description: Path strings looked up in context.entries; each requested path uses the first entry with an exactly equal path, and repeated strings are counted repeatedly. An empty array produces the design-only result.

outputs.name: hubSize
outputs.description: Returns an object with available and text. For a non-empty path list, available is true only if every first exact-path match has a safe-integer size; the text reports the repeated sum divided by 1024 to one decimal KB, or Not measured: source size unavailable, while an empty list returns Not measured: design only.
